'''Eben Kinahay''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Talus/Legends|Talus]]. Kinahay lived on an [[Eben Kinahay's estate|estate]] located on an island on the [[Sapphire Lake]], in the settlement [[Hollowtown]] on [[Centerpoint Station]]. An antiquities dealer and collecter, Kinahay owned a [[Eben Kinahay's Sith holocron|Sith holocron]], which had been recovered from a derelict [[Starship/Legends|starship]] on the planet [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]]. He expected that his son, [[Zyne Kinahay]], would follow in his footsteps as an antiquities dealer, and he allowed Zyne access to his vast collection, in hope that doing so would cause Zyne to develop a passion for ancient art. However, unknown to Eben, Zyne was [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] and studied from Eben's [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]].<ref name="CatCW" />
